Here is the weekly ASX X (Twitter) thread for the week of 2026-08-03:

Post 1

📈 ASX 200 closed at 8,547 pts last week. Bulls need follow-through; bears need a catalyst. The dominant tension: can domestic momentum hold as global rate uncertainty creeps back in? Cautious lean into the week. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2

🏦 Banks face margin scrutiny ahead of earnings season, while ⛏️ miners watch iron ore after recent price softness. Two sectors, two different pressure points — both worth positioning around this week. #ASX #banking #ironore #mining

Post 3

Results season heats up with heavyweights reporting. One stock carrying outsized weight: BHP, where every $1/t move in iron ore shifts earnings materially. Watch the guidance tone closely. #ASX #mining #BHP #ausbiz

Post 4

S&P 500 holding above 5,600 pts gives ASX a constructive floor, but USD strength is compressing commodity prices. If the greenback stays bid, materials and energy names absorb the headwind first. #ASX #SPX #ausbiz #commodities

Post 5

RBA decision lands Tuesday. Market pricing sits near no change, but the statement tone is everything. A hawkish tilt hits rate-sensitives hard; a dovish pivot lifts property and growth names. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #interestrates
